in_hindi.long_meaning: शिक्षावता (Teacher) + विजय (Victory) + देव (God) = देवजीत (God of Victory)

in_marathi.name: Devjeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘deva’ (god) and ‘jit’ (victory). This name symbolizes the triumph of the divine over worldly challenges.
